name: Zombie Escape Survivor Rescue
summary:
Get ready for an intense survival adventure in a world overrun by zombies! In Zombie Escape: Survivor Rescue, your mission is clear—save the survivors, fight off hordes of the undead, and make it out alive. Armed with a range of powerful guns, you’ll navigate through dangerous environments, rescue stranded people, and face relentless challenges at every step.

🧟 Key Features
Rescue Missions: Brave zombie-infested zones to save survivors before it’s too late. Every life matters!
